name: Blox Fruits
tagline: Latest working Blox Fruits codes for free XP boosts, Beli and stat resets.
description: Blox Fruits is a Roblox One Piece-inspired adventure where players sail the seas, master Devil Fruits and fight bosses. New codes drop with each update, giving free 2x XP boosts, in-game Beli, fragments and stat resets. This page is updated whenever a new code is released so you can grab every reward before it expires.

redeemSteps.title: Launch Blox Fruits
redeemSteps.detail: Open Roblox and start a Blox Fruits session. You can be on any island or in any sea.

redeemSteps.title: Open the main menu
redeemSteps.detail: Press M on PC or tap the menu icon on mobile to bring up the in-game menu.

redeemSteps.title: Click the Twitter / X icon
redeemSteps.detail: Inside the menu, click the small blue bird icon. A code redemption text box will appear.

redeemSteps.title: Paste the code
redeemSteps.detail: Copy a code from this page and paste it exactly as shown — codes are case-sensitive.

redeemSteps.title: Hit Try
redeemSteps.detail: Press the Try button. Valid codes will instantly grant the reward.

faq.question: How often are new Blox Fruits codes released?
faq.answer: New codes usually drop alongside major updates, milestones (likes/visits) and developer livestreams — roughly every 2–4 weeks.

faq.question: Why is my Blox Fruits code not working?
faq.answer: Codes are case-sensitive and expire fast. Make sure you copied the code exactly as listed. If it still fails, it has likely expired — check the Expired Codes page.

faq.question: Can I redeem a code twice?
faq.answer: No. Each Blox Fruits code can only be redeemed once per account.

codes.notes: Released after the latest update livestream.
